name: Standing toe touch
instructions: Warm up for a few minutes, then stand barefoot with your feet together. If you can already reach past your toes, stand on a sturdy step or box so you can go lower.
Keep both knees fully straight and fold forward slowly, reaching both hands down together with the middle fingers level.
Hold the lowest point for 2 seconds without bouncing.
Have someone measure the vertical distance from your middle fingertips to the level of your toes.
Record past the toes as a positive number and short of the toes as a negative number. Touching the toes is 0.
Take the best of two tries.
